Fatima Menon
Frontend Engineer | Secunderabad
fatima.menon447@example.com | +91 9499485010

Product-focused frontend engineer with a strong emphasis on building performant, accessible user interfaces. Skilled at translating product requirements into modular React components and shipping features that improve conversion and engagement. Comfortable working across design, backend APIs, and QA to deliver end-to-end web experiences.

Experience
Dream11 — Jan 2024 - Present
Frontend Engineer (Remote)
- Implemented a component-driven betting dashboard using TypeScript, React and Next.js, reducing initial load time by 32% through route-based code splitting and image optimization.
- Collaborated with product and design to rebuild the contest creation flow; refactored CSS into modular styles and improved form completion rate by 18% while maintaining cross-browser consistency.
- Introduced shared UI primitives and documentation in Confluence, accelerating feature development by enabling three teams to reuse TypeScript React components and cut duplicate UI work by ~25%.
- Improved CI build reliability on Linux runners and automated visual regression checks, reducing regressions in production releases by 40%.

PhonePe — Apr 2021 - Dec 2023
UI Engineer (On-site)
- Led the overhaul of a payments settings area using React and Tailwind CSS, which increased user settings completion by 22% and reduced CSS bundle size by 15% through utility-first refactor.
- Built a responsive onboarding experience with React and plain CSS that improved mobile activation conversion by 14% and maintained 90+ Lighthouse accessibility scores for core pages.
- Partnered with backend and QA to stabilize frontend releases on Linux-based pipelines, decreasing post-release bugs by 30% through better automated end-to-end tests and linting.
- Authored Confluence runbooks and component usage guidelines for the UI team, shortening ramp time for new hires and reducing UI inconsistencies across products.

Projects
- Component Library — Created a small internal React + TypeScript component library showcased on Confluence; included Storybook examples and usage notes, adopted by two product teams.
- Performance Audit Toolkit — Built lightweight audit scripts running on Linux to collect Lighthouse metrics for PRs, used to prevent regressions and track perf improvements over time.

Skills
Languages: TypeScript
Frameworks/Stack: React, Next.js
Styling/UX: CSS, Tailwind CSS
Tools/Other: Confluence, Linux

B.E., Information Technology, Pune University
